title: Demonstrate the Project and Answer Questions

blocks.title: Demonstrate the same reviewed project
blocks.text: STORY Presentation Path: situation, target, operations, result, and your judgment. Prepare a five-to-seven-minute demonstration with useful visuals, human decisions, supported results, and honest limits. AI may ask practice questions; you answer for the work.

SUPPLIED FICTIONAL TRAINING CASE: The reviewed intake tabletop shows complete input and a missing-date or absent-approval exception. Its author demonstrates the revised written status and human delivery gate, opens retained check references, and explains what changed after testing. A first fictional rehearsal lasts 8:20; after removing prompt repetition and putting the exception reference beside the cue, a second fictional full rehearsal lasts 6:10. These supplied observations do not establish your rehearsal, live delivery, measured savings, real organizational permission, or certification.
